claims.text: All four frozen original cases produce an actual nonzero retained-row Boolean certificate, independently replayed by V9, and emit joined typed source-only training features and restricted target/proof records through the real CLI.
Exact source/protocol/config/capture custody, limits, requested unsupported SAT status and original-source public allowlists survive plan/generate/verify/export; failures remain visible.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No clock/performance claim; no second Generate. Repeat independent read-only verification/export on existing artifacts is a determinism/custody check, not A/A timing.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No additional generated negative cells. Required prerequisite source-gate receipts cover malformed/sticky-budget/source/capture/proof/unsupported routing controls; four real cells also request SAT and must receive explicit unsupported. Full m2..15/policy cohort is retained in a plan-only control, never mislabeled as executed.

positive.expected_detection: The frozen genuine original16384 identities previously passed the strict native producer gate; both f4 and f5 with both twists must now yield actual nonzero identity and typed export. Refusal does not satisfy this detector. No planted or substituted target.

decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Not applicable; no effect-size or performance claim
decision_rule.interval: Not applicable to an exact finite software contract
decision_rule.text: PASS only for conjunction of four cell contracts and the global pipeline contract. Otherwise report FAIL for an observed contract violation, INTERRUPTED for infrastructure interruption, or NOT_EXECUTED for unmet preconditions; retain evidence and do not repeat automatically.
decision_rule.threshold: 4 of4 cell contracts plus every global command/custody/export assertion pass

inadmissible: Generating or building while unrelated source validation is active or without source/binary/gate reconciliation.
Freezing a template containing unresolved hashes, mutable source/binary/analysis paths, or fabricated software gate receipts.
Reusing interrupted output, renewing original deadlines, rerunning Generate, adding cells, or changing seed/resources after outcomes.
Calling the hidden worker directly in place of actual Generate supervisor coverage.
Treating scientific_corpus_rows or verified_cloud_cells as positive; both remain0 for this local software smoke.
Interpreting runtime, PMU, modeled ledgers or native counters as comparative or complete instruction evidence.
Publishing remote datasets, changing cloud permissions, or treating checkpoint archives as scientific dataset uploads.
invalidation_rules: Source/binary mismatch, dirty embedded provenance, stale validation gates, missing original binding, wrong adapter, missing/duplicate canonical artifacts, failed replay, expired/interrupted worker, or missing command receipt invalidates all-success.
Failure and timeout rows are retained and charged as attempts; no exclusion creates success. Unattempted remaining cells are explicitly reported.
Unavailable or multiplexed counters are preserved under actual scope; they cannot be promoted to complete hardware instruction measurements.

literature.claim: Actual fixed mathematical inputs and original launch limits, software source contract.

Reviewed Boolean quotient/source-only feature semantics; no novelty claim.

instance_sampling.rule: The two actual-twist instances per solver are a finite profile-coverage set from the same frozen plan; no statistical independence or population-generalization claim. Curve/generator/key construction does not depend on solver arm.

seed_derivation.note: crypto DatasetPlan::cell and curves::generate use frozen seed42 and one curve/generator/key per twist; no protocol-hash-derived replacement seeds.

power.note: Two arms times two twist cases equals four exact coverage checks. passes describes adequacy for this finite conjunction, not a run outcome or statistical power. Alpha is schema-required and unused; no p-values or effect detection.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly four generated cells, one Generate; then registered verify/status/export/report, repeat export and plan-only broad control; no further generated cases.
Stop immediately on nonzero command or failed prerequisite/assertion; preserve all completed and partial artifacts. No automatic rerun, timeout renewal or resampling.

Per-cell original60s, Generate wrapper300s plus explicit bounded kill grace, short commands45s and verify/export/report120s, total driver1800s. No new cloud/S3 production spend; original overall200USD cap remains unchanged.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: No clock, speed, stochastic performance, or comparative claim. Each finite command/artifact assertion is exact; repeated A/A executions would add samples outside this four-cell functional check.
